changelog:
Initial release of operational-heartbeat.

- Automates daily health checks for OpenClaw instances.
- Verifies presence of the daily memory file; creates it if missing.
- Analyzes cron job schedules, flags overdue or errored jobs.
- Summarizes system health and reports any issues.
- Designed for scheduled execution via cron.
